installTitle: Keep the app on your phone

zakat.title: My zakat
zakat.onlyHereLong: Kept only on this phone. Nothing is sent to anyone.
zakat.notice: Saved only on this phone. Clear all data or a new phone removes it. The app does not calculate zakat.
zakat.owedHint: Enter the amount yourself. The app does not calculate zakat.
zakat.label: Year
zakat.full: The list is full (500 payments). Remove one, or start a new year.
zakat.resetBody: This removes the amount owed and every payment in this list from this phone.

push.title: Notifications
push.intro: Get timing changes, notices and dua requests from your masjids.
push.blockedAndroid: Open the phone's Settings → Apps → this app (or your browser) → Notifications, and allow them. Then come back here.
push.blockedIos: Open the iPhone's Settings → Notifications → {app}, and allow notifications.
push.blockedDesktop: Click the lock icon next to the address, allow notifications, and open this page again.
push.installFirstBody: On iPhone, notifications work only in the installed app. Add it to your Home Screen, then open it from there.
push.unsupportedBody: This browser cannot show notifications. The app still shows every update when you open it.
push.error: Could not change notifications. Please try again.
push.noMasjids: Follow a masjid to get its notifications.
